title: XFACTA: CONTEMPORARY, REAL-WORLD DATASET AND EVALUATION FOR MULTIMODAL MISINFORMATION DETECTION WITH MULTIMODAL LLMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and benchmarking of a misinformation detection dataset (XFACTA). While it contains a standard ethics statement regarding the usage of social media data, it does not evaluate or benchmark aspects of religion, faith, morals, or theological ethics.
